speaker: Max
text: I lean over the table. "I'm going to rob the Merchant Bank on market day. Are you in?"

speaker: Corvin
text: "I'm in," Corvin says, rolling a coin across his knuckles. "I'll make sure the night guards look the other way. But I want my cut up front."

speaker: Narrator
text: They shake hands over the chalk map of the bank. The plan is agreed.
